paragraphs: Brightly sells software to track and manage the entire asset lifecycle for facilities, equipment and infrastructure. After being acquired by Siemens in 2022, the business now goes to market as Siemens.

Asset Essentials, the maintenance product, combines work order management, data and analytics, and automated preventive maintenance workflows. An AI-powered Maintenance Copilot automates routine work and surfaces instructions, summaries and safety information. Other products handle full asset lifecycle prediction modeling and capital planning. There is facility scheduling and event management software as well. Utilities are covered by cloud-based energy management software. For government infrastructure, the pitch is managing a complex network of assets in one centralized register. Field work is scheduled and allocated with native GIS capabilities.

The company describes more than 25 years supporting clients across industries in keeping critical assets and infrastructure running. It says 11,000+ organizations use the software to manage asset lifecycles. Case studies on the site include Loyola University New Orleans.
